issues.display_title: Issue #1696: Portfolio Logo Is Wiped on Every About Save
issues.main_description_html:
Problem

POST /portfolios (PortfolioController@createPortfolio) always writes logo into the update payload, and $logo falls back to '' whenever the request carries no file:

if (isset($fileName) && strlen($fileName) > 0) {
    $logo = "http://gothru.co/moderation/" . $userId . "/" . $fileName;
} else {
    $logo = '';   // <- wipes the stored logo
}

The dashboard only appends logo when a new file is picked, so saving the About form after changing any other field clears the stored logo. It is silent: the UI keeps showing the old image until the page is reloaded.

The same payload also makes "logo removed" and "logo untouched" indistinguishable — the remove button only appears to work because of this bug.

Expected behavior

  • A save that carries no logo keeps whatever is already stored.
  • Clearing the logo requires an explicit signal from the client.
  • The old file on disk is removed when the logo is replaced or cleared.

Acceptance criteria

  • Saving the About form without re-picking a logo leaves portfolio.logo unchanged.
  • Uploading a new logo replaces the value and unlinks the previous file.
  • remove_logo clears the value and unlinks the previous file.
  • Unlinking a file that is already gone does not raise a warning.

Related

  • Frontend issue: GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4135
  • PR: #1695

Dev update — 2026-07-22

PR #1695 (base main), commit e2d96342f, one file: PortfolioController@createPortfolio.

The current logo is read once up front, and $logo now resolves three ways instead of two:

request result
new file new URL, old file unlinked
remove_logo '', old file unlinked
neither unchanged — this is the fix

INSERT path stays safe: no row means $oldLogo is ''. The unlink is now in one place for both paths, behind an is_file guard.

php -l clean. No automated test — the controller builds every collaborator with new in its constructor, so covering it needs a DI refactor bigger than the fix. Manual: (1) change only the phone → save → reload, logo intact; (2) upload new logo, old file gone; (3) remove logo, value and file gone.

Merge before GoThruMedia/gothru-dashboard#4134 — alone this fixes the wipe but the remove button stays inert until the client sends remove_logo.

Still open in this endpoint: mimes:png returns a bare 400 with no field detail; BASE_DIR vs the /data/ unlink path only agree if BASE_DIR is /data/moderation/; success returns data.message while errors return data.messages.

issues.display_title: Issue #1703: Return Each Tour's Portfolio Visibility in the List Response
issues.main_description_html:
• Endpoint: GET /portfolios/panoramas → listPortfolioPanoramas (PortfolioController.php:252)
  • New property: is_public

Context

The list query (:279) selects business_name, tour_url, cid, thumb_url and the rest — but not the visibility column. So the frontend has no way to draw the checkbox in the right state.

Add is_public to every item in data.list.

It is the inverse of the stored column, and the stored column has three states, not two:

not_public in the database is_public in the response
"0" true
"" (empty) true
"1" false

Empty counts as public — that is how the existing readers already treat it (whereIn('not_public', ["0", ""])). Getting this wrong makes every never-touched tour look hidden.

Return it as a real JSON boolean, not "0" / "1", so the frontend isn't parsing strings into a checkbox.

Acceptance criteria

  • Every item in data.list carries is_public
  • The value is a boolean
  • A tour with an empty not_public returns is_public: true
  • A tour with not_public = "1" returns is_public: false
  • No other property in the response changes

issues.display_title: Issue #1704: Endpoint to Set Portfolio Visibility — One Tour or the Whole Account
issues.main_description_html:
• Column written: not_public

Context

Nothing currently writes not_public. One endpoint covers both cases — ticking a single checkbox and Show All / Hide All. The frontend does not get a separate single-tour endpoint.

So the request needs two things: the direction (is_public true/false) and the target — either a set of tours, or the whole account.

The target must be explicit. An empty or missing tour list must never be treated as "everything" — that turns one frontend bug into a customer's entire portfolio going dark. Make "whole account" something the caller has to say on purpose, and reject a request that names no target at all.

Bulk must be one operation, not one per tour. An agency account with 500 tours has to work.

Note: editPortfolio (used by /portfolio/edit) writes a different flag, is_checked — leave it alone, that page is out of scope.

Where the data lives
Connection googlemaps — DatabaseClass::dbGoogleMaps()
Table google_plus — reached via DatabaseClass::tableGooglePlus()
Column to write not_public
Row identifier used by the frontend cid
Account scope user_id — every read and write must carry it

Values are compared as strings throughout the existing code — whereIn('not_public', ["0", ""]), $portfolio == true ? "1" : "0". Write strings, not integers or booleans, or the existing readers will miss the rows.

There is no migration for this table in the repo — it is a legacy schema. Check the live table before assuming a type, and don't add or alter columns as part of this issue. Nothing here needs a schema change; it writes a column that already exists.

For the all path, the update is a single statement scoped by user_id. Worth confirming user_id is indexed on google_plus before shipping — a 500-tour account is small, but this table holds every account's tours.

Proposed contract

Adjust the shape if something fits the codebase better — but keep scope explicit and keep is_public meaning the same thing it means in the list response.

POST /portfolios/panoramas/visibility

Single tour — what the checkbox sends:

{
  "is_public": false,
  "scope": "selected",
  "cids": ["1234567890123456789"]
}

Whole account — what Show All / Hide All sends:

{
  "is_public": true,
  "scope": "all"
}
Field Rules
is_public required, boolean. true writes not_public = "0", false writes "1"
scope required, one of selected | all
cids required when scope is selected, array, at least one entry. Ignored when scope is all

Response carries the same summary block the summary endpoint returns, so the frontend can refresh both counts without calling it again:

{
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "messages": "...",
    "summary": {
      "total": 42,
      "total_public": 18
    }
  }
}

Rejections:

Case Result
scope missing, or selected with empty / absent cids 400, nothing written
cids containing tours that belong to another account not written — reject the request rather than silently skipping
no token / expired 401

Acceptance criteria

  • scope: "selected" with one cid sets that tour public or hidden
  • scope: "all" sets every tour on the account public or hidden
  • scope missing, or selected with an empty or absent cids, returns 400 and writes nothing
  • The all path ignores any search or paging state
  • The all path completes in reasonable time for a 500-tour account, as one operation
  • A cid belonging to another account is never written — every query is scoped by user_id
  • The column is written as a string ("0" / "1"), matching how existing readers compare it
  • The response carries the summary block reflecting the state after the change
  • Failure returns a clear message the frontend can show
  • Manually verified: toggling a tour changes what appears at gothru.co/port/{code}

issues.display_title: Issue #1705: Endpoint Returning the Portfolio Visibility Counts
issues.main_description_html:
• Endpoint: GET /portfolios/panoramas/summary — new route, separate from the list

Context

The summary bar shows "18 of 42 shown at portfolio". The frontend cannot work this out without loading every page, so the counts come from their own call — not bolted onto the list response.

Both numbers are account-wide and ignore search and paging entirely. The endpoint takes no query parameters at all: someone on page 3 of 12, or mid-search, still needs their true public total. The same counts drive the Show All / Hide All label, so they must not shift when the customer searches.

pagination.total_data on the list endpoint is a different number — rows matching the current search, used for paging. It keeps its current meaning and is not touched by this issue.

Response shape

{
  "last_login": "...",
  "encrypt": "...",
  "summary": {
    "total": 42,
    "total_public": 18
  }
}
Field Meaning
summary.total every tour on the account, hidden included
summary.total_public tours on the account currently public

Counted from google_plus scoped by user_id. A tour with an empty not_public counts as public — same three-state trap as the list property.

The visibility endpoint returns this same summary block after a write, so a single toggle does not cost a second round trip.

Acceptance criteria

  • GET /portfolios/panoramas/summary returns both counts for the logged-in user
  • The endpoint accepts no search or paging parameters
  • Tours with an empty not_public are counted as public
  • Counts cover the whole account, never one page
  • The list endpoint response is unchanged by this issue
